# Working of the Program

#### Course: Learn Recursion With Java

## Working of the Program

![Each Recursive Call Returns ](data:image/png;base64,)

When the base condition is reached, the final method returns "Done".

The string "Done" is returned by each recursive call (starting with the method call that satisfies the base condition) until this value is returned to the original method call.

The original method call then returns this value to the output variable, where "Done" is finally stored.

It's important to note that in each method call, we print the value of n before recursively calling the method. Thus, the numbers 1 and 2 are printed before the base case starts returning "Done".

Next, we will modify this program so that each method call returns a different value.
